# Scores for genes whose pathway the split divides, and genes whose it does not (generated by experiments/score_by_pathway_split.py)

451 perturbations, 5 disease-cluster folds (seed 0); out-of-fold predictions pooled across folds; macro AUPRC over symptoms with at least 5 positives in the stratum; paired bootstrap over perturbations (1000 resamples). A gene is in the split-pathway stratum when a gene in another fold has the same primary Human-GEM subsystem (catch-all subsystems excluded).

## split pathway: 271 genes, 9 symptoms scored

| model | macro AUPRC | lift over popularity | minus random walk, paired [95% CI] |
|---|---|---|---|
| popularity | 0.205 | +0.000 | -0.072 [-0.100, -0.054] |
| degree_popularity | 0.232 | +0.027 | -0.044 [-0.071, -0.010] |
| random_walk_with_restart | 0.277 | +0.072 | reference |
| b3_typed_nodes | 0.228 | +0.023 | -0.049 [-0.075, -0.023] |
| b6_mechanistic_gate_time_scales | 0.255 | +0.050 | -0.022 [-0.051, +0.023] |
| b6_linear_response_gate_time_scales_cofactors | 0.239 | +0.035 | -0.037 [-0.068, -0.005] |
| b3_linear_response_cofactors | 0.204 | -0.001 | -0.073 [-0.099, -0.048] |
